lede: The web spent the day at the movies. The final trailer for Avengers: Doomsday drew 55,201,638 views on YouTube ahead of its December 18 release, and Grand Theft Auto VI turned up on Wikipedia, YouTube and Google Trends at once, a title that moves every kind of feed. Away from the screen, Miss Universe 2026 led Wikipedia with 394,056 reads, and Nvidia chief Jensen Huang surfaced across a news wire and Wikipedia both.

throughlines.title: Magneto vs Doctor Doom | Avengers Doomsday New Teaser
throughlines.gist: Marvel’s next crossover is arriving: the final trailer is already past 55 million YouTube views with the film due December 18, and the Wikipedia page is climbing right alongside it.

throughlines.title: At AI speed , Nvidia Jensen Huang finds exoneration
throughlines.gist: Nvidia’s chief executive is live on a news wire and Wikipedia in the same window, a sign the company’s story is back near the center of the day.

throughlines.title: Aaron Rodgers was released by the Stealers?
throughlines.gist: The veteran quarterback is pulling Wikipedia traffic and Bluesky chatter at once, an NFL story moving on both the reference and the social side.
